name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-cloud-tileset
title: Redrawn Styled Cloud Tileset
description:
For those redrawn style enthusiasts, this pack that promises to expand the original cloud stuff from Super Mario World Redrawn may be useful.

It adds new faces and sizes for the original redrawn cloud stuff from SMWR, useful if you want to create a cloud section or just make your hack more varied.

It uses palette 7 from SMWR (so if you're using this hack graphics the palette included isn't necessary), and a great map16 slot.

Also includes upside down versions for each cloud, which act as 1C8 (but being a bit glitched).

NOTE 1: Tile 3F7 just mimics the original cloud (happy and upside up), so you can ignore it and use global tiles cloud if you want.

NOTE 2: The pack also includes GFX14 from SMWR that contains the redrawn cloud graphic if you're not using SMWR.
